sloka: विशालान् कोसलान् रम्यान् यात्वा लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः ।अयोध्याभिमुखो धीमान् प्राञ्ञ्लिर्वाक्वमब्रवीत् ॥२-५०-१॥
transliteration: viśālān kosalān ramyān yātvā lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ ।ayodhyābhimukho dhīmān prāññlirvākvamabravīt ॥2-50-1॥

translations.english: Having crossed the vast, beautiful kingdom of Kosala, the sagacious elder brother of Lakshmana stood facing Ayodhya with folded palms and said:
